title: Subspace evaluation character
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $H$ be a subspace of $(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$, and let $x\in(\mathbb{F}_2)^n$. The evaluation character associated with $x$ sends each $\gamma\in H$ to the value at $x$ of the Walsh character indexed by $\gamma$.
